title: 2021 AMC 10A Problem 2
statement: Portia’s high school has \(3\) times as many students as Lara’s high school. The two high schools have a total of \(2600\) students. How many students does Portia’s high school have?

solutions.text:
Let \(x\) be the number of students in Lara’s high school. Then Portia’s high school has \(3x\) students.

Therefore, \[ \begin{aligned} 3x + x &= 2600 \\ x &= 650. \end{aligned} \] Then \(3x = 1950.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
